card_a.name: Source Currency to Base Currency Exchange Rate
card_a.description: Specifies the Source Currency to Base Currency Exchange Rate applied to this transaction when Visa converts the source amount to the transaction amount in the destination currency. The format of this field is SSRRRRRR, where: SS = Scale Factor. These positions represent number of digits to the right of the decimal point in the currency conversion rate field. The first two positions will be 00 through 12. RRRRRR = Conversion Rate — A scale factor of zeros means the entry is a whole number. — A scale factor of 01 means the number has one decimal place accuracy; RRRRR.R is entered as 01RRRRRR. — A scale factor of 02 means the number has two decimal place accuracy; RRRR.RR is entered as 02RRRRRR and so forth. — For a scale factor greater than 6, as many leading zeros as necessary should be inserted; for example, .00RRRRRR is entered as 08RRRRRR. Outgoing: This field will be populated by the VIC. Incoming: This field will contain the currency exchange rate applied to this transaction by Visa. This field will contain zeroes if currency conversion does not apply or the source currency is the same as the base currency.

card_b.name: Source Currency to Base Currency Exchange Rate
card_b.description: Specifies the Source Currency to Base Currency Exchange Rate applied to this transaction when Visa converts the source amount to the transaction amount in the destination currency. The format of this field is SSRRRRRR, where: SS = Scale Factor. These positions represent number of digits to the right of the decimal point in the currency conversion rate field. The first two positions will be 00 through 12. RRRRRR = Conversion Rate — A scale factor of zeros means the entry is a whole number. — A scale factor of 01 means the number has one decimal place accuracy; RRRRR.R is entered as 01RRRRRR. — A scale factor of 02 means the number has two decimal place accuracy; RRRR.RR is entered as 02RRRRRR and so forth. — For a scale factor greater than 6, as many leading zeros as necessary should be inserted; for example, .00RRRRRR is entered as 08RRRRRR. Outgoing: This field will be populated by the VIC. Incoming: This field will contain the currency exchange rate applied to this transaction by Visa. This field will contain zeroes if currency conversion does not apply or the source currency is the same as the base currency.

card_a.name: Base Currency to Destination Currency Exchange Rate
card_a.description: Specifies the Base Currency to Destination Currency Exchange Rate applied to this transaction when Visa converts the source amount to the transaction amount in the destination currency. The format of this field is SSRRRRRR where: SS = Scale Factor. These positions represent number of digits to the right of the decimal point in the currency conversion rate field. The first two positions will be 00 through 12. RRRRRR = Conversion Rate — A scale factor of zeros means the entry is a whole number. — A scale factor of 01 means the number has one decimal place accuracy; RRRRR.R is entered as 01RRRRRR. — A scale factor of 02 means the number has two decimal place accuracy; RRRRR.RR is entered as 02RRRRRR and so forth. — For a scale factor greater than 6, as many leading zeros as necessary should be inserted; for example, .00RRRRRR is entered as 08RRRRRR. Outgoing: This field will be populated by the VIC. Incoming: The field will contain the currency exchange rate applied to this transaction by Visa. The field will contain zeros if currency conversion does not apply or the destination currency is the same as the base currency.

card_b.name: Base Currency to Destination Currency Exchange Rate

The first two positions will be 00 through 12. Outgoing: This field will be populated by the VIC. Incoming: The field will contain the currency exchange rate applied to this transaction by Visa. The field will contain zeros if currency conversion does not apply or the destination currency is the same as the base currency.

card_a.name: Optional Issuer ISA Amount
card_a.description: This ISO-defined field can be used for any charge type or any fee applied to a transaction. Currently, Visa uses this field to carry optional International Service Assessment (ISA) data for issuers in the LAC region. The optional issuer ISA amount in this field is not included in the destination amount. Optional issuer ISA amounts are calculated in conjunction with ISA processing, but they are not included in settlement amounts or subject to acquirer allocation. The field is calculated by the VIC when the Optional Issuer ISA percentage is defined in the clients’ profile. The Optional Issuer ISA Amount is in the destination currency; two decimal places are implied.

card_b.name: Payment Facilitator Name

card_a.name: Customer Reference Code
card_a.description: This field will contain a code that denotes whether the customer identification data belongs to the sender or the recipient. The values are: 05 (Payer (sender)) 06 (Payee (recipient))

card_b.name: Customer Reference Code
card_b.description: This field will contain a code that denotes whether the customer identification data belongs to the sender or the recipient. The values are: 05 (Payer (sender)) 06 (Payee (recipient))

card_a.name: Identification Type Code
card_a.description: This field is a conditional field. This is present only when Customer Reference Code is 05, 06. This field will contain the type of sender identification. The valid values are: BTHD (Date of birth) 1 CUID (Customer identification (unspecified)) NTID (National identification) PASN (Passport number) DRLN (Driver license) TXIN (Tax identification) CPNY (Company registration number) PRXY (Proxy identification) SSNB (Social security number) ARNB (Alien registration number) LAWE (Law enforcement identification) MILI (Military identification) TRVL (Travel identification (non-passport)) EMAL (Email) PHON (Phone number)

card_b.name: Identification Type Code
card_b.description: This field is a conditional field. This is present only when Customer Reference Code is 05, 06. This field will contain the type of sender identification. The valid values are: BTHD (Date of birth) 1 CUID (Customer identification (unspecified)) NTID (National identification) PASN (Passport number) DRLN (Driver license) TXIN (Tax identification) CPNY (Company registration number) PRXY (Proxy identification) SSNB (Social security number) ARNB (Alien registration number) LAWE (Law enforcement identification) MILI (Military identification) TRVL (Travel identification (non-passport)) EMAL (Email) PHON (Phone number)

card_a.name: Identification Subtype
card_a.description: This field is a conditional field. This is present only when Customer Reference Code is 05, 06. This field will contain a value populated by the originating acquirer to identify the sender. It must be left-justified and space-filled. When positions 116-119 contain the value of BTHD (Date of birth), 1 this field will contain a date of birth in ccyymmdd format where: cc = century yy = year mm = month dd = day

card_b.name: Identification Value

card_a.description: This field is a conditional field. This is present only when Customer Reference Code is 05, 06. This field will contain the 3-digit ISO country code of the sender when positions 116-119 contains an applicable value.

card_b.description: This field is a conditional field. This is present only when Customer Reference Code is 05, 06. This field will contain the 3-digit ISO country code of the sender when positions 116-119 contains an applicable value.

sections_matched.title_a: TC 10 - BASE II Clearing Fee Collection Transactions

card_a.name: Transaction Code
card_a.description: The field must contain a 10.

card_b.name: Transaction Code
card_b.description: The field must contain a 10.

card_a.name: Transaction Code Qualifier
card_a.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Transaction Code Qualifier
card_b.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_a.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero).

card_b.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_b.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero).

card_a.name: Destination Identifier
card_a.description: The entity to which this BASE II transaction message is sent. This field must contain spaces or a valid identifier to receive monetary items. If spaces are entered, the VIC inserts the destination identifier based on the account number (if the account number is a numeric other than all zeros).

card_b.name: Destination Identifier
card_b.description: The entity to which this BASE II transaction message is sent. This field must contain spaces or a valid identifier to receive monetary items. If spaces are entered, the VIC inserts the destination identifier based on the account number (if the account number is a numeric other than all zeros).

card_a.name: Source Identifier
card_a.description: The entity from which this BASE II transaction message was sent. This field must contain a valid identifier to send monetary items.

card_b.name: Source Identifier
card_b.description: The entity from which this BASE II transaction message was sent. This field must contain a valid identifier to send monetary items.

card_a.name: Reason Code
card_a.description: A VisaNet code that tells the receiving client the reason for the Fee Collection. This field must contain a valid four-digit Funds Disbursement Reason Code (for example, 5310 - ATM Cash Disbursement Issuer Credit). See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for Fee Collection/Funds Disbursement Reason Codes.

card_b.name: Reason Code
card_b.description: A VisaNet code that tells the receiving client the reason for the Fee Collection. This field must contain a valid four-digit Funds Disbursement Reason Code (for example, 5310 - ATM Cash Disbursement Issuer Credit). See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for Fee Collection/Funds Disbursement Reason Codes.

card_a.name: Country Code
card_a.description: A three-digit code that represents the country involved. If the Funds Disbursement Reason Code equals 0100 or 0190, the field must contain a valid country code followed by a space. If the Funds Disbursement Reason Code is 0300 the country code must be CA or BR. The field must contain spaces for all other Funds Disbursement Reason Codes. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for a list of country codes.

card_b.name: Country Code
card_b.description: A three-digit code that represents the country involved. If the Funds Disbursement Reason Code equals 0100 or 0190, the field must contain a valid country code followed by a space. If the Funds Disbursement Reason Code is 0300 the country code must be CA or BR. The field must contain spaces for all other Funds Disbursement Reason Codes. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for a list of country codes.

card_a.name: Event Date
card_a.description: The date of the event for which the funds disbursement is being initiated. The field must contain a valid four-digit date in the format MMDD.

card_b.name: Event Date
card_b.description: The date of the event for which the funds disbursement is being initiated. The field must contain a valid four-digit date in the format MMDD.

card_a.name: Account Number
card_a.description: An issuer-assigned number that identifies a cardholder's account. Outgoing: The entry must be a 16-digit numeric. The first nine characters must be valid per the current ARDEF Table. For account numbers less than 16 digits, zero-fill to the right. The entry must be the correct length, must check digit. VIC Edit: The entry must represent either the Destination Identifier or Source Identifier according to the ARDEF Table. Account numbers are required on some transactions depending on the specified Funds Disbursement Reason Code. See the Funds Disbursement Reason Code table in BASE II Clearing Data Codes to determine which reason code requires an account number. Incoming: The edit criteria is the same as for outgoing except that the field must be filled with zeros for those Funds Disbursement Reason Codes so specified in the Fee Collection/Funds Disbursement Reason Codes table located in BASE II Clearing Data Codes.

card_b.name: Account Number
card_b.description: An issuer-assigned number that identifies a cardholder's account. Outgoing: The entry must be a 16-digit numeric. The first nine characters must be valid per the current ARDEF Table. For account numbers less than 16 digits, zero-fill to the right. The entry must be the correct length, must check digit. VIC Edit: The entry must represent either the Destination Identifier or Source Identifier according to the ARDEF Table. Account numbers are required on some transactions depending on the specified Funds Disbursement Reason Code. See the Funds Disbursement Reason Code table in BASE II Clearing Data Codes to determine which reason code requires an account number. Incoming: The edit criteria is the same as for outgoing except that the field must be filled with zeros for those Funds Disbursement Reason Codes so specified in the Fee Collection/Funds Disbursement Reason Codes table located in BASE II Clearing Data Codes.

card_a.name: Account Number Extension
card_a.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If used, the field must be left-justified and zero-filled to the right. The field is used for account numbers greater than 16 digits. The Outgoing Edit Package inserts zeros if there are spaces or if the account number is all zeros.

card_b.name: Account Number Extension
card_b.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If used, the field must be left-justified and zero-filled to the right. The field is used for account numbers greater than 16 digits. The Outgoing Edit Package inserts zeros if there are spaces or if the account number is all zeros.

card_a.name: Destination Amount
card_a.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the destination endpoint. Outgoing: The field must contain zeros. Incoming: The field must contain a number greater than zero and it must be the same as the Outgoing Source Amount. The VIC converts the Source Amount to the Destination Amount. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the VIC moves the Source Amount to the Destination Amount field.
card_a.note: Two decimals are implied.

card_b.name: Destination Amount
card_b.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the destination endpoint. Outgoing: The field must contain zeros. Incoming: The field must contain a number greater than zero and it must be the same as the Outgoing Source Amount. The VIC converts the Source Amount to the Destination Amount. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the VIC moves the Source Amount to the Destination Amount field.
card_b.note: Two decimals are implied.

card_a.name: Destination Currency Code
card_a.description: The currency type presented to the client on incoming transactions. For most transactions (that is, drafts), it is the billing currency. For other transactions (for example, fee collection, dispute financial), it is the settlement currency of the destination. Outgoing: The field must contain spaces. Incoming: The field must contain a valid ISO numeric code. The VIC inserts the settlement currency of the receiving processing center. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the Destination Currency Code will be the same as the Source Currency Code.

card_b.name: Destination Currency Code
card_b.description: The currency type presented to the client on incoming transactions. For most transactions (that is, drafts), it is the billing currency. For other transactions (for example, fee collection, dispute financial), it is the settlement currency of the destination. Outgoing: The field must contain spaces. Incoming: The field must contain a valid ISO numeric code. The VIC inserts the settlement currency of the receiving processing center. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the Destination Currency Code will be the same as the Source Currency Code.

card_a.name: Source Amount
card_a.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the source endpoint. Outgoing: The field must be numeric and be greater than zero. The Source Amount cannot exceed the maximum amount allowed by the Reason Code. Two decimals are implied. To perform the edit check, the VIC converts the amount to U.S. Dollars if it is not already so, and returns the transaction if the converted amount exceeds the maximum allowed for the Funds Disbursement Reason Code (see BASE II Clearing Data Codes for Funds Disbursement Reason Codes). Incoming: The field must be numeric and be greater than zero.
card_a.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Source Amount
card_b.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the source endpoint. Outgoing: The field must be numeric and be greater than zero. The Source Amount cannot exceed the maximum amount allowed by the Reason Code. Two decimals are implied. To perform the edit check, the VIC converts the amount to U.S. Dollars if it is not already so, and returns the transaction if the converted amount exceeds the maximum allowed for the Funds Disbursement Reason Code (see BASE II Clearing Data Codes for Funds Disbursement Reason Codes). Incoming: The field must be numeric and be greater than zero.
card_b.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.name: Source Currency Code
card_a.description: The currency type associated with the amount of a transaction entered into interchange. This field must contain a valid ISO numeric code.
card_a.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Source Currency Code
card_b.description: The currency type associated with the amount of a transaction entered into interchange. This field must contain a valid ISO numeric code.
card_b.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.name: Format Code
card_a.description: Used to ensure a valid Visa reference number. The entry must be a 7.

card_b.name: Format Code
card_b.description: Used to ensure a valid Visa reference number. The entry must be a 7.

card_a.name: Message Text Field for Reason Code 0300
card_a.description: This field can be used for a freeform text message for transactions with a Reason Code of 0300. This field is used only in Brazil and Canada Bill Payment Service.

card_b.name: Message Text Field for Reason Code 0300
card_b.description: This field can be used for a freeform text message for transactions with a Reason Code of 0300. This field is used only in Brazil and Canada Bill Payment Service.

card_a.name: Acquirer Reference Number
card_a.description: A 23-digit identification number assigned by the acquirer and associated with every draft/voucher. It consists of a format code, acquiring identifier, capture date, file locator, and check digit.

card_b.name: Acquirer Reference Number
card_b.description: A 23-digit identification number assigned by the acquirer and associated with every draft/voucher. It consists of a format code, acquiring identifier, capture date, file locator, and check digit.

card_a.name: Acquiring Identifier
card_a.description: A numeric used to identify an acquiring financial institution. An acquiring identifier may also be assigned to client or non-client processing for identification purposes. The entry must represent either the destination identifier or the source identifier.

card_b.name: Acquiring Identifier
card_b.description: A numeric used to identify an acquiring financial institution. An acquiring identifier may also be assigned to client or non-client processing for identification purposes. The entry must represent either the destination identifier or the source identifier.

card_a.name: Date
card_a.description: The entry must contain a four-digit numeric in the format YDDD (year and Julian day).

card_b.name: Date
card_b.description: The entry must contain a four-digit numeric in the format YDDD (year and Julian day).

card_a.name: Film Locator
card_a.description: A number used to identify film records of the transaction. This field must contain an 11-digit numeric. The entry may be zeroes if the center has other provisions for quick retrieval of originals/photocopies.

card_b.name: Film Locator
card_b.description: A number used to identify film records of the transaction. This field must contain an 11-digit numeric. The entry may be zeroes if the center has other provisions for quick retrieval of originals/photocopies.

card_a.name: Check Digit
card_a.description: A digit added to the end of an account number of Acquirer Reference Number that is derived from a computation using a predetermined formula and the preceding digits of the account number. It is used during editing processes to validate account numbers and acquirer Reference Numbers. This entry must be a valid standard modulus-10 check digit of the preceding 22 digits (positions 77-98).

card_b.name: Check Digit
card_b.description: A digit added to the end of an account number of Acquirer Reference Number that is derived from a computation using a predetermined formula and the preceding digits of the account number. It is used during editing processes to validate account numbers and acquirer Reference Numbers. This entry must be a valid standard modulus-10 check digit of the preceding 22 digits (positions 77-98).

card_a.name: Bank Name
card_a.description: The name of the bank. An entry is required and must be space-filled to the right.

card_b.name: Bank Name
card_b.description: The name of the bank. An entry is required and must be space-filled to the right.

card_a.name: Bank City
card_a.description: The city where the bank is located. An entry is required and must be space-filled to the right.

card_b.name: Bank City
card_b.description: The city where the bank is located. An entry is required and must be space-filled to the right.

card_a.name: Merchant Category Code
card_a.description: A code designating the principal trade, profession, or line of business in which a merchant is engaged. The entry must be 6010.

card_b.name: Merchant Category Code
card_b.description: A code designating the principal trade, profession, or line of business in which a merchant is engaged. The entry must be 6010.

card_a.name: Transfer Type
card_a.description: Type of transfer being made. The entry must be 00, 01, or 02: 00 = Cardholder payment 01 = Returned/invalid account 02 = Returned/other reason

card_b.name: Transfer Type
card_b.description: Type of transfer being made. The entry must be 00, 01, or 02: 00 = Cardholder payment 01 = Returned/invalid account 02 = Returned/other reason

card_a.name: Reserved
card_a.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_b.name: Reserved
card_b.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.name: Settlement Flag
card_a.description: Indicates the service used for settlement. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for a definition of the Settlement Flag codes. Outgoing: The field must contain 0, 7 (valid only for Latin America and Caribbean), 8, or 9. If 7, or 8 are entered, both the Source and Destination identifiers must be non-U.S. Incoming: The field must contain 0, 7 (valid only for Latin America and Caribbean), or 8.
card_a.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Settlement Flag
card_b.description: Indicates the service used for settlement. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for a definition of the Settlement Flag codes. Outgoing: The field must contain 0, 7 (valid only for Latin America and Caribbean), 8, or 9. If 7, or 8 are entered, both the Source and Destination identifiers must be non-U.S. Incoming: The field must contain 0, 7 (valid only for Latin America and Caribbean), or 8.
card_b.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.name: Transaction Identifier
card_a.description: A unique value that Visa assigns to each transaction and returns to the acquirer in the authorization response. Visa uses this value to maintain an audit trail throughout the life cycle of the transaction and all related transactions, such as reversals, adjustments, confirmations, and dispute financials. This field must be numeric. The entry must be either zeros or a valid Transaction Identifier. For fulfillment and nonfulfillment fee transactions (Reason Codes 5160 and 5170), the Transaction Identifier from the corresponding transaction will be included.

card_b.name: Transaction Identifier
card_b.description: A unique value that Visa assigns to each transaction and returns to the acquirer in the authorization response. Visa uses this value to maintain an audit trail throughout the life cycle of the transaction and all related transactions, such as reversals, adjustments, confirmations, and dispute financials. This field must be numeric. The entry must be either zeros or a valid Transaction Identifier. For fulfillment and nonfulfillment fee transactions (Reason Codes 5160 and 5170), the Transaction Identifier from the corresponding transaction will be included.

card_a.name: Country Code
card_a.description: A three-digit code that represents the country involved. If the Funds Disbursement Reason Code equals 0100 or 0190, the field must contain a valid country code followed by a space. If the Funds Disbursement Reason Code is 0300 the country code must be CA or BR. The field must contain spaces for all other Funds Disbursement Reason Codes. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for a list of country codes.

card_b.name: Country Code

See BASE II Clearing Data Codes for a list of country codes.

card_a.name: Event Date

card_b.name: Event Date

card_a.name: Account Number
card_a.description: An issuer-assigned number that identifies a cardholder's account. Account numbers are required on some transactions depending on the specified Funds Disbursement Reason Code. See the Funds Disbursement Reason Code table in BASE II Clearing Data Codes to determine which reason code requires an account number. Outgoing: When the field is required, the entry must be a 16-digit numeric. The first nine characters must be valid per the current ARDEF Table. For account numbers less than 16 digits, zero-fill to the right. The entry must be the correct length, must check digit. VIC Edit: The entry must represent either the Destination Identifier or Source Identifier according to the ARDEF Table.

card_b.name: Account Number
card_b.description: An issuer-assigned number that identifies a cardholder's account. Account numbers are required on some transactions depending on the specified Funds Disbursement Reason Code. See the Funds Disbursement Reason Code table in BASE II Clearing Data Codes to determine which reason code requires an account number. Outgoing: When the field is required, the entry must be a 16-digit numeric. The first nine characters must be valid per the current ARDEF Table. For account numbers less than 16 digits, zero-fill to the right. The entry must be the correct length, must check digit. VIC Edit: The entry must represent either the Destination Identifier or Source Identifier according to the ARDEF Table.

card_a.name: Account Number Extension
card_a.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If used, the field must be left-justified and zero-filled to the right. The field is used for account numbers greater than 16 digits. The Outgoing Edit Package inserts zeros if there are spaces or if the account number is all zeros.

card_b.name: Account Number Extension

card_a.name: Destination Amount
card_a.description: The amount that is credited to the destination identifier. Outgoing: The field must contain zeros. Incoming: The field will contain a number greater than zero. The VIC converts the Source Amount to the Destination Amount. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the VIC moves the Source Amount to the Destination Amount field. Two decimals are implied.

card_b.name: Destination Amount
card_b.description: The amount that is credited to the destination identifier. Outgoing: The field must contain zeros. Incoming: The field will contain a number greater than zero. The VIC converts the Source Amount to the Destination Amount. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the VIC moves the Source Amount to the Destination Amount field. Two decimals are implied.

card_a.name: Destination Currency Code
card_a.description: The currency type presented to the client on incoming transactions. Outgoing: The field must contain spaces. Incoming: The field will contain a valid ISO numeric code. The VIC inserts the settlement currency of the receiving processing center. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the Destination Currency Code will be the same as the Source Currency Code.

card_b.name: Destination Currency Code
card_b.description: The currency type presented to the client on incoming transactions. Outgoing: The field must contain spaces. Incoming: The field will contain a valid ISO numeric code. The VIC inserts the settlement currency of the receiving processing center. For National Net and Bilateral transactions, the Destination Currency Code will be the same as the Source Currency Code.

card_a.name: Source Amount
card_a.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the source endpoint. The amount that will be debited to the source identifier. Outgoing: The field must be numeric and be greater than zero. The Source Amount cannot exceed the maximum amount allowed by the Reason Code. Two decimals are implied. To perform the edit check, the VIC converts the amount to U.S. Dollars if it is not already so, and returns the transaction if the converted amount exceeds the maximum allowed for the Funds Disbursement Reason Code (see BASE II Clearing Data Codes for Funds Disbursement Reason Codes).
card_a.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run. Incoming: The field must contain a numeric greater than zero.

card_b.name: Source Amount
card_b.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the source endpoint. The amount that will be debited to the source identifier. Outgoing: The field must be numeric and be greater than zero. The Source Amount cannot exceed the maximum amount allowed by the Reason Code. Two decimals are implied. To perform the edit check, the VIC converts the amount to U.S. Dollars if it is not already so, and returns the transaction if the converted amount exceeds the maximum allowed for the Funds Disbursement Reason Code (see BASE II Clearing Data Codes for Funds Disbursement Reason Codes).
card_b.note: This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run. Incoming: The field must contain a numeric greater than zero.

card_a.name: Source Routing Flag
card_a.description: Flag identifying the source of the transaction. Flags are: I = Transaction from issuer. This is for dispute requests. A = Transaction from acquirer. This is used to send nonfulfillments to issuers. S = Transaction from secondary acquirer. This is used to send secondary acquirer fulfillments and nonfulfillments to issuers and acquirers. M = Transaction from merchant. This is used to send merchant fulfillments and nonfulfillments to issuers and acquirers. V = Transaction from Visa. This is used for VCRFS or VDAS advices. VIC Edit: The field must contain an I, A, S, M, or V. It must be a valid code for the Transaction Type. For Transaction Type A, it must be I or V. For Transaction Type P, it must be A. For Transaction Type C or R, it must be I or A or V.

M = Transaction from merchant. This is used to send merchant fulfillments and nonfulfillments to issuers and acquirers. V = Transaction from Visa. This is used for VCRFS or VDAS advices. It is also used for VDAS advices. V = Transaction to Visa. This is used for dispute requests. VIC Edit: The field must contain an I, A, M, or V. card_b.description: The type of transaction contained in this TCR. The transaction type flags are: C = Chargeback D = Dispute R = Representment F = Fulfillment V = Reserved for Visa internal use VIC Edit: The field must contain a C, D, R, F, or V.

card_a.name: Source Routing Flag
card_a.description: Flag indicating from whom the transaction was sent. The Source Routing Flags are: I = Transaction from issuer A = Transaction from acquirer S = Transaction from secondary acquirer M = Transaction from merchant V = Transaction from Visa VIC Edit: The field must contain an I, A, S, M, or V.

card_b.name: Source Routing Flag
card_b.description: Flag indicating from whom the transaction was sent. The Source Routing Flags are: I = Transaction from issuer A = Transaction from acquirer S = Transaction from secondary acquirer M = Transaction from merchant V = Transaction from Visa VIC Edit: The field must contain an I, A, S, M, or V.

card_a.name: Destination Routing Flag
card_a.description: Flag indicating to whom the transaction is being sent (destined): acquirer, issuer, or Visa. The Destination Routing Flags are: A = Transaction to acquirer I = Transaction to issuer VIC Edit: The field must contain an A or I.

card_b.name: Destination Routing Flag
card_b.description: Flag indicating to whom the transaction is being sent (destined): acquirer, issuer, or Visa. The Destination Routing Flags are: A = Transaction to acquirer I = Transaction to issuer VIC Edit: The field must contain an A or I.

card_a.name: Return Flag
card_a.description: Reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_b.description: Reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.description: Indicates the settlement impact; also, the settlement service in which the transaction will settle: the International Settlement Service or a National Area Net Service. VIC Edit: If provided from the VCRFS/VDAS advice, this field should contain the Settlement Flag. This field must contain the Settlement Flag from the chargeback or representment.

card_b.name: Settlement Flag

card_b.name: Message Transaction Number
card_b.description: This field indicates the sequence of the transaction within the message, for example, the first transaction in the message has a Transaction Number of 00001. VIC Edit: The field must contain a numeric entry which is greater than zero.

card_b.name: Public Network Trace Number
card_b.description: VIC Edit: Transactions which originated at a Public Network user can contain a trace number inserted by the Public Network Gateway. The receiver is not required to retain this trace number. This field may contain spaces.

card_a.name: Acquirer Reference Number (ARN)
card_a.description: A 23-digit identification number assigned by the acquirer and associated with every draft/voucher. It contains a format code, acquiring identifier, capture date, file locator, and check digit. This field must contain the Acquirer Reference Number from the chargeback or representment. This number is included in a Clearing Record. The ARN should be unique although duplicate ARNs will not be rejected. VIC Edit: The Format Code in Position 62 of the ARN must contain either a 2 or a 7.

card_b.name: Acquirer Reference Number (ARN)
card_b.description: A 23-digit identification number assigned by the acquirer and associated with every draft/voucher. It contains a format code, acquiring identifier, capture date, file locator, and check digit. This field must contain the Acquirer Reference Number from the dispute or dispute response. This number is included in a Clearing Record. The ARN should be unique although duplicate ARNs will not be rejected. VIC Edit: The Format Code in Position 62 of the ARN must contain either a 2 or a 7.

card_a.name: Account Number
card_a.description: Contains the Account Number from the chargeback or representment. Account numbers are required on some transactions depending on the specified Funds Disbursement Reason Code. Refer to BASE II Clearing Data Codes to determine which reason code requires an account number. VIC Edit: If the Destination Routing Flag is I, the field must contain a valid account number. Fulfillments sent to issuers must contain the account number from the VCRFS/VDAS advice.

card_b.name: Account Number
card_b.description: Contains the Account Number from the dispute or dispute response. Account numbers are required on some transactions depending on the specified Funds Disbursement Reason Code. Refer to BASE II Clearing Data Codes to determine which reason code requires an account number. VIC Edit: If the Destination Routing Flag is I, the field must contain a valid account number. Fulfillments sent to issuers must contain the account number from the VCRFS/VDAS advice.

card_a.name: Account Number Extension
card_a.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If the account number exceeds 16 digits, the extension field entry must be numeric, left-justified, and any remaining positions zero-filled. Outgoing: The Edit Package inserts zeros in the field if the Account Number is 16 digits or less (per the ARDEF Table). VIC Edit: The field must contain zeros if Account Number is 16 digits or fewer.

card_b.name: Account Number Extension
card_b.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If the account number exceeds 16 digits, the extension field entry must be numeric, left-justified, and any remaining positions zero-filled. Outgoing: The Edit Package inserts zeros in the field if the Account Number is 16 digits or less (per the ARDEF Table). VIC Edit: The field must contain zeros if Account Number is 16 digits or fewer.

card_a.name: Transaction Identifier (TID)
card_a.description: A unique value that Visa assigns to each transaction and returns to the acquirer in the authorization response. Visa uses this value to maintain an audit trail throughout the lifecycle of the transaction and all related transactions, such as reversals, adjustments, confirmations, and chargebacks. VIC Edit: The field must contain a numeric entry. It must be either zeros or a valid Transaction Identifier. For fulfillment transactions destined for issuers, if the Acquirer Reference Number Format Code is a 2, this field may not be zeros. If the ARN format code is a 7, this field must be zeros. This field must contain the Transaction Identifier from the chargeback or representment.

card_b.name: Transaction Identifier (TID)
card_b.description: A unique value that Visa assigns to each transaction and returns to the acquirer in the authorization response. Visa uses this value to maintain an audit trail throughout the lifecycle of the transaction and all related transactions, such as reversals, adjustments, confirmations, and chargebacks. VIC Edit: The field must contain a numeric entry. It must be either zeros or a valid Transaction Identifier. For fulfillment transactions destined for issuers, if the Acquirer Reference Number Format Code is a 2, this field may not be zeros. If the ARN format code is a 7, this field must be zeros. This field must contain the Transaction Identifier from the dispute or dispute response.

card_a.name: Excluded Transaction Identifier Reason
card_a.description: This field contains a code indicating that a transaction identifier is not included in the transaction. Use of this field ensures that certain transactions that do not have a transaction identifier can be processed successfully through the VisaNet systems. This field contains the value from the TC 38.

card_b.name: Excluded Transaction Identifier Reason
card_b.description: This field contains a code indicating that a transaction identifier is not included in the transaction. Use of this field ensures that certain transactions that do not have a transaction identifier can be processed successfully through the VisaNet systems. This field contains the value from the TC 38.

card_a.name: Multiple Clearing Sequence Number
card_a.description: This field contains a sequence number that distinguishes a specific clearing message among multiple clearing messages being submitted for a single CPS authorization from a chargeback or representment. All BASE II clearing messages linked to a single authorization request must contain a unique clearing sequence number from at least 1 to the total number of clearing records (Field 62.12-Multiple Clearing Sequence Count) for the authorization. This entry must be numeric. Outgoing: For transactions from non-CPS participating merchants, the Edit Package zero-fills this field.

card_b.name: Multiple Clearing Sequence Number
card_b.description: This field contains a sequence number that distinguishes a specific clearing message among multiple clearing messages being submitted for a single CPS authorization from a dispute or dispute response. All BASE II clearing messages linked to a single authorization request must contain a unique clearing sequence number from at least 1 to the total number of clearing records (Field 62.12-Multiple Clearing Sequence Count) for the authorization. This entry must be numeric. Outgoing: For transactions from non-CPS participating merchants, the Edit Package zero-fills this field.

card_b.name: Network Identification Code

card_b.name: Transaction Amount

card_a.description: The actual date a cardholder makes a purchase; this is the date of the transaction. This field must contain the Purchase Date from the chargeback or representment. The entry must be a four-digit numeric (which may be zeros) in the format MMDD (month and day).

card_b.name: Purchase Date

card_b.description: The date (based on Greenwich Mean Time) on which a client enters Interchange data to, and the data is accepted by, a VisaNet Interchange Center (VIC). VIC Edit: Insert the date when the transaction was processed. The date format is YDDD (year and day).

card_a.name: Transmission Date and Time
card_a.description: Contains the date and time the request or advice was submitted to VisaNet. The date and time must be in mmdd format. GMT (Greenwich mean time) can be used. Transmission date and time is a key data element used to match a response to its request or advice. This field indicates when a transaction entered the network. The sender of a transaction enters a new date and time with each request. The receiving client saves the field and returns it in the response message. This field is used in every message generated by acquirers and issuers and is present in every message generated by VisaNet. The format will be MMDDHHMMSS (month, day, hour, minute, second). The ISO field is 7.

card_b.name: Transmission Date and Time
card_b.description: Contains the date and time the request or advice was submitted to VisaNet. The date and time must be in mmdd format. GMT (Greenwich mean time) can be used. Transmission date and time is a key data element used to match a response to its request or advice. This field indicates when a transaction entered the network. The sender of a transaction enters a new date and time with each request. The receiving client saves the field and returns it in the response message. This field is used in every message generated by acquirers and issuers and is present in every message generated by VisaNet. The format will be MMDDHHMMSS (month, day, hour, minute, second). The ISO field is 7.

card_b.name: Transaction Amount
card_b.description: The total transaction amount between a cardholder and a merchant, or between a cardholder and a client. card_a.name: Cardholder Billing Currency Code
card_a.description: Numeric code that identifies the currency used by the issuer to bill the cardholder's account. The ISO field is 51.

card_b.name: Cardholder Billing Currency Code
card_b.description: Numeric code that identifies the currency used by the issuer to bill the cardholder's account. The ISO field is 51.

card_a.name: Transaction Currency Code
card_a.description: Code that identifies the currency of the amount field(s). When the "Cardholder Billing Currency Code" field is not present, this field contains the currency of the amount specified in the "Transaction Amount" field. The ISO field is 49.

card_b.name: Transaction Currency Code
card_b.description: Code that identifies the currency of the amount field(s). When the "Cardholder Billing Currency Code" field is not present, this field contains the currency of the amount specified in the "Transaction Amount" field. The ISO field is 49.

card_a.name: Cardholder Billing Conversion Rate
card_a.description: Contains the rate used by Visa to convert the transaction amount to cardholder billing amount. The value is the conversion rate plus the Visa conversion charge, plus or minus any optional issuer fee. The optional issuer fee, expressed as a percentage, may be positive or negative; that is, the transaction amount multiplied by this rate equals the cardholder billing amount.
card_a.note: Visa uses either a buy rate or a sell rate for currency conversion, depending on the message type and the exchange direction. Visa uses both U.S. dollar-based buy/sell rate pairs and buy/sell rate pairs of currencies other than the U.S. dollar. For more information, refer to the Multicurrency Service description in the V.I.P. System Services manual. The ISO field is 10.

card_b.name: Cardholder Billing Conversion Rate
card_b.description: Contains the rate used by Visa to convert the transaction amount to cardholder billing amount. The value is the conversion rate plus the Visa conversion charge, plus or minus any optional issuer fee. The optional issuer fee, expressed as a percentage, may be positive or negative; that is, the transaction amount multiplied by this rate equals the cardholder billing amount.
card_b.note: Visa uses either a buy rate or a sell rate for currency conversion, depending on the message type and the exchange direction. Visa uses both U.S. dollar-based buy/sell rate pairs and buy/sell rate pairs of currencies other than the U.S. dollar. For more information, refer to the Multicurrency Service description in the V.I.P. System Services manual. The ISO field is 10.

card_a.name: Expiration Date
card_a.description: The expiration date of this record in Julian format (YYYYDDD). This field will contain 9999365 if the record does not expire. The format of this field will be YYMM (year, month). The ISO field is 14.

card_b.name: Expiration Date
card_b.description: The expiration date of this record in Julian format (YYYYDDD). This field will contain 9999365 if the record does not expire. The format of this field will be YYMM (year, month). The ISO field is 14.

card_a.name: Acquiring Institution ID
card_a.description: This code identifies the financial institution acting as the acquirer of a customer transaction. The acquirer is the client or system user that signed the merchant or ADM or dispensed cash. This number is usually a Visa-assigned identifier. When a processing center operates for multiple acquirers, this code is for the individual client or system user, not a code for the center. Codes other than Visa identifiers can be supported; for example, this ID may be a routing and transit number that complies with the ISO 7812 standard. The ISO field is 32.

card_b.name: Acquiring Institution ID
card_b.description: This code identifies the financial institution acting as the acquirer of a customer transaction. The acquirer is the client or system user that signed the merchant or ADM or dispensed cash. This number is usually a Visa-assigned identifier. When a processing center operates for multiple acquirers, this code is for the individual client or system user, not a code for the center. Codes other than Visa identifiers can be supported; for example, this ID may be a routing and transit number that complies with the ISO 7812 standard. The ISO field is 32.

card_a.name: Acquiring Institution Country Code
card_a.description: Code identifying the country where the acquirer is located. The ISO field is 19.

card_b.name: Acquiring Institution Country Code
card_b.description: Code identifying the country where the acquirer is located. The ISO field is 19.

card_a.name: Message Type
card_a.description: Number that identifies the type of V.I.P. message.

card_b.name: Message Type
card_b.description: Number that identifies the type of V.I.P. message.

card_a.name: Processing Code
card_a.description: Code used to identify the type of transaction (positions 1 and 2) and, if applicable, the type of account affected (positions 3 and 4). The ISO field is 3 (positions 1-4).

card_b.name: Processing Code
card_b.description: Code used to identify the type of transaction (positions 1 and 2) and, if applicable, the type of account affected (positions 3 and 4). The ISO field is 3 (positions 1-4).

card_a.name: POS Condition Code
card_a.description: Code identifying transaction conditions at the point of sale or point of service, thus, in many cases, identify a type of original or subsequent transactions. This field is used in all customer transaction-related messages. In several message types that may follow an original transaction (including CRS), this field contains the code that identifies the type of processing being done. The ISO field is 25.

card_b.name: POS Condition Code
card_b.description: Code identifying transaction conditions at the point of sale or point of service, thus, in many cases, identify a type of original or subsequent transactions. This field is used in all customer transaction-related messages. In several message types that may follow an original transaction (including CRS), this field contains the code that identifies the type of processing being done. The ISO field is 25.

card_a.name: Merchant Type
card_a.description: Code describing the merchant's type of business product or service, also known as the merchant category code (MCC). These codes are based on the Merchant Classification Code Guideline available from the Bank Card Division of the ABA. Valid codes are listed in the Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules, as amended by additions and changes published in VisaNet Business Enhancements and in Technical Letters for clients. This field must be numeric. The ISO field is 18.

card_b.name: Merchant Type
card_b.description: Code describing the merchant's type of business product or service, also known as the merchant category code (MCC). These codes are based on the Merchant Classification Code Guideline available from the Bank Card Division of the ABA. Valid codes are listed in the Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules, as amended by additions and changes published in VisaNet Business Enhancements and in Technical Letters for clients. This field must be numeric. The ISO field is 18.

card_a.name: POS Entry Mode
card_a.description: A V.I.P. System field indicating the method by which a point-of- transaction terminal obtains and transmits the cardholder information necessary to complete a transaction. When the POS Entry Mode is 90, this field contains positions 1 and 3 of ISO field 22. In all other cases, this field contains positions 2 and 3 of ISO field 22.

card_b.name: POS Entry Mode
card_b.description: A V.I.P. System field indicating the method by which a point-of- transaction terminal obtains and transmits the cardholder information necessary to complete a transaction. When the POS Entry Mode is 90, this field contains positions 1 and 3 of ISO field 22. In all other cases, this field contains positions 2 and 3 of ISO field 22.

card_a.name: POS Entry Capability
card_a.description: Point-of-sale entry capability. The ISO field is 60 (positions 1, 2, 5, and 6).

card_b.name: POS Entry Capability
card_b.description: Point-of-sale entry capability. The ISO field is 60 (positions 1, 2, 5, and 6).

card_a.name: Card Acceptor Terminal ID
card_a.description: Contains a code that identifies a terminal at the card acceptor location, by itself or in conjunction with the Card Acceptor Identification Code. This field is used in all messages related to a customer transaction. If this field is present in a request, it must be preserved and returned in the response. The ISO field is 41.

card_b.name: Card Acceptor Terminal ID
card_b.description: Contains a code that identifies a terminal at the card acceptor location, by itself or in conjunction with the Card Acceptor Identification Code. This field is used in all messages related to a customer transaction. If this field is present in a request, it must be preserved and returned in the response. The ISO field is 41.

card_a.name: Card Acceptor ID
card_a.description: Code that identifies the card acceptor. The ISO field is 42.

card_b.name: Card Acceptor ID
card_b.description: Code that identifies the card acceptor. The ISO field is 42.

card_a.name: Retrieval Reference Number
card_a.description: Contains a number that is used with other data elements as a key to identify and track all messages related to a given cardholder transaction, that is, to a given transaction set. These sets are: Authorization l Purchase l Merchandise return l Cash disbursement (manual cash) l The ISO field is 37.

card_b.name: Retrieval Reference Number
card_b.description: Contains a number that is used with other data elements as a key to identify and track all messages related to a given cardholder transaction, that is, to a given transaction set. These sets are: Authorization l Purchase l Merchandise return l Cash disbursement (manual cash) l The ISO field is 37.

card_a.name: Payment Indicator
card_a.description: This U.S.-only field contains a code indicating the type of goods purchased over the Internet. The ISO field is 60 (positions 9 and 10).

card_b.name: Payment Indicator
card_b.description: This U.S.-only field contains a code indicating the type of goods purchased over the Internet. The ISO field is 60 (positions 9 and 10).

card_a.name: Reserved
card_a.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_b.name: Reserved
card_b.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.name: Reimbursement Attribute
card_a.description: Obsolete - must be zero-filled.

card_b.name: Reimbursement Attribute
card_b.description: Obsolete - must be zero-filled.

card_a.description: The field must contain 48.

card_b.name: Transaction Code
card_b.description: The field must contain 48.

card_a.name: Transaction Code Qualifier
card_a.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Transaction Code Qualifier
card_b.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_a.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero).

card_b.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_b.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero).

card_a.name: Destination Identifier
card_a.description: The entity to which a BASE II transaction message is sent. Outgoing: This field should contain spaces. Incoming: This field will contain a valid issuing identifier. If spaces are entered, the VIC inserts the destination identifier based on the account number.

card_b.name: Destination Identifier
card_b.description: The entity to which a BASE II transaction message is sent. Outgoing: This field should contain spaces. Incoming: This field will contain a valid issuing identifier. If spaces are entered, the VIC inserts the destination identifier based on the account number.

card_a.name: Source Identifier
card_a.description: The entity from which this BASE II transaction message was sent. Outgoing: This field must contain a valid acquiring identifier for sending transactions. Incoming: This field must contain 400050.

card_b.name: Source Identifier
card_b.description: The entity from which this BASE II transaction message was sent. Outgoing: This field must contain a valid acquiring identifier for sending transactions. Incoming: This field must contain 400050.

card_a.name: Format Code
card_a.description: The entry must be either a 2 (chip card informational advice) or a 7.

card_b.name: Format Code
card_b.description: The entry must be either a 2 (chip card informational advice) or a 7.

card_a.name: Account Number
card_a.description: An account number is a primary cardholder account number that is either: Embossed and encoded on a Visa Card or l Encoded on an Electron Card, a Proprietary Card bearing the PLUS l Symbol, or a card bearing the Visa Electron Symbol. This field must contain a valid account number (13-digit or 16-digit), left- justified and right-zero-filled.

card_b.name: Account Number
card_b.description: An account number is a primary cardholder account number that is either: Embossed and encoded on a Visa Card or l Encoded on an Electron Card, a Proprietary Card bearing the PLUS l Symbol, or a card bearing the Visa Electron Symbol. This field must contain a valid account number (13-digit or 16-digit), left- justified and right-zero-filled.

card_a.name: Authorization Response Code
card_a.description: Code indicating issuer's reply to an Authorization Request. Authorization Responses include: Approval Response l Decline Response l Pickup Response l Referral Response l For custom payment service credit vouchers and their reversals, this field must contain spaces. The field contains the authorization code provided by the issuer when a transaction is approved or a "no reason to decline" code provided for successful verifications. The entry must be two alphanumeric characters; spaces, A through Z, or 0 through 9. For chip transactions that are processed offline, this field must contain the offline authorization code.

card_b.name: Authorization Response Code
card_b.description: Code indicating issuer's reply to an Authorization Request. Authorization Responses include: Approval Response l Decline Response l Pickup Response l Referral Response l For custom payment service credit vouchers and their reversals, this field must contain spaces. The field contains the authorization code provided by the issuer when a transaction is approved or a "no reason to decline" code provided for successful verifications. The entry must be two alphanumeric characters; spaces, A through Z, or 0 through 9. For chip transactions that are processed offline, this field must contain the offline authorization code.

card_a.name: Destination Amount
card_a.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the destination endpoint. Outgoing: The field must contain zeros. The VIC converts the Source Amount to the Destination Amount. Two decimals are implied. Incoming: The field will contain a numeric value.

card_b.name: Destination Amount
card_b.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the destination endpoint. Outgoing: The field must contain zeros. The VIC converts the Source Amount to the Destination Amount. Two decimals are implied. Incoming: The field will contain a numeric value.

card_a.name: Destination Currency Code
card_a.description: The currency type presented to the client on incoming transactions. For most transactions (that is, drafts), it is the billing currency. For other transactions (for example, fee collection, dispute financial), it is the settlement currency of the destination. Outgoing: The VIC inserts the Issuer Currency Code. The field must contain zeros. Incoming: The field will contain the ISO numeric code for the Issuer's billing currency.

card_b.name: Destination Currency Code
card_b.description: The currency type presented to the client on incoming transactions. For most transactions (that is, drafts), it is the billing currency. For other transactions (for example, fee collection, dispute financial), it is the settlement currency of the destination. Outgoing: The VIC inserts the Issuer Currency Code. The field must contain zeros. Incoming: The field will contain the ISO numeric code for the Issuer's billing currency.

card_a.name: Source Amount
card_a.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the source endpoint. The entry must be numeric. Two decimal places are implied.

card_b.name: Source Amount
card_b.description: Identifies the submitted transaction amount in the currency that is appropriate to the source endpoint. The entry must be numeric. Two decimal places are implied.

card_a.name: Source Currency Code
card_a.description: The currency type associated with the source amount of the transaction. The field must contain a valid ISO numeric currency code.

card_b.name: Source Currency Code
card_b.description: The currency type associated with the source amount of the transaction. The field must contain a valid ISO numeric currency code.

card_a.name: POS Entry Mode
card_a.description: A V.I.P. system field indicating the method by which a point-of- transaction terminal obtains and transmits the cardholder information necessary to complete a transaction. When the POS Entry Mode is 90, this field contains positions 1 and 3 of ISO field 22. In all other cases, this field contains positions 2 and 3 of ISO field 22. This field must be spaces, 00 through 06, 10, 90, or 95. Please see BASE II Clearing Data Codes manual for a list of valid codes.

card_b.name: POS Entry Mode
card_b.description: A V.I.P. system field indicating the method by which a point-of- transaction terminal obtains and transmits the cardholder information necessary to complete a transaction. When the POS Entry Mode is 90, this field contains positions 1 and 3 of ISO field 22. In all other cases, this field contains positions 2 and 3 of ISO field 22. This field must be spaces, 00 through 06, 10, 90, or 95. Please see BASE II Clearing Data Codes manual for a list of valid codes.

card_a.name: POS Terminal Capability
card_a.description: Indicates the capability of the point-of-sale terminal to obtain an authorization and process transaction data. The field must contain a space, 0 through 5, or 9. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes manual for a list of valid codes.

card_b.name: POS Terminal Capability
card_b.description: Indicates the capability of the point-of-sale terminal to obtain an authorization and process transaction data. The field must contain a space, 0 through 5, or 9. See BASE II Clearing Data Codes manual for a list of valid codes.

card_a.name: Merchant Name
card_a.description: The merchant or client name (for cash disbursements) imprinted on the transaction receipt by the merchant's or client's imprinter plate. It should be the "doing business as" (DBA) name of the merchant or client and the one most recognizable to cardholders. The merchant name as shown in the original presentment must be included in all dispute financials, retrieval requests, and dispute response financials. The first position of this field cannot be a space. The field must be space- filled to the right.

card_b.name: Merchant Name
card_b.description: The merchant or client name (for cash disbursements) imprinted on the transaction receipt by the merchant's or client's imprinter plate. It should be the "doing business as" (DBA) name of the merchant or client and the one most recognizable to cardholders. The merchant name as shown in the original presentment must be included in all dispute financials, retrieval requests, and dispute response financials. The first position of this field cannot be a space. The field must be space- filled to the right.

card_a.name: Merchant City
card_a.description: The name of the city where the transaction took place. The first position of this field cannot be a space. The field must be space-filled to the right.

card_b.name: Merchant City
card_b.description: The name of the city where the transaction took place. The first position of this field cannot be a space. The field must be space-filled to the right.

card_a.name: Merchant Country Code
card_a.description: Identifies the country code of the merchant location where the transaction took place. The entry must be a valid BASE II code. The first two characters must be the alpha country code. The third character must be a space.

card_b.name: Merchant Country Code
card_b.description: Identifies the country code of the merchant location where the transaction took place. The entry must be a valid BASE II code. The first two characters must be the alpha country code. The third character must be a space.

card_a.name: Merchant ZIP Code
card_a.description: Identifies the ZIP code of the merchant location where the transaction took place. This field must be numeric. It may be zeros.

card_b.name: Merchant ZIP Code
card_b.description: Identifies the ZIP code of the merchant location where the transaction took place. This field must be numeric. It may be zeros.

card_a.name: Network Identification Code
card_a.description: This field will include the network identification code. Valid values are 0000-9999. For transactions that do not contain network identification code, this field should contain all zeros.

card_b.name: Network Identification Code
card_b.description: This field will include the network identification code. Valid values are 0000-9999. For transactions that do not contain network identification code, this field should contain all zeros.

card_a.name: Merchant State/Province Code
card_a.description: Code designating merchant's state or province code. If the Merchant Country Code is US or CA, this field must contain a valid U.S. State Code or Canadian Province Code, respectively. Otherwise it must contain spaces.

card_b.name: Merchant State/Province Code
card_b.description: Code designating merchant's state or province code. If the Merchant Country Code is US or CA, this field must contain a valid U.S. State Code or Canadian Province Code, respectively. Otherwise it must contain spaces.

card_a.name: Card Acceptor ID
card_a.description: The identifier of the card acceptor operating the point-of-sale or point-of-service terminal or at the ATM in local and in interchange environments. Depending on the acquirer or merchant billing and reporting requirements, the acquirer-assigned code can represent a merchant, a specific merchant location, or a specific merchant location terminal. This field must contain alphanumeric values.

card_b.name: Card Acceptor ID
card_b.description: The identifier of the card acceptor operating the point-of-sale or point-of-service terminal or at the ATM in local and in interchange environments. Depending on the acquirer or merchant billing and reporting requirements, the acquirer-assigned code can represent a merchant, a specific merchant location, or a specific merchant location terminal. This field must contain alphanumeric values.

card_a.name: Terminal ID
card_a.description: Code identifying the card acceptor terminal or ATM. For electronic point-of-sale or point-of-service (POS) terminals, when the ID is not unique to a specific terminal, Card Acceptor Identification Code can be used along with this field. This field must contain alphanumeric values.

card_b.name: Terminal ID
card_b.description: Code identifying the card acceptor terminal or ATM. For electronic point-of-sale or point-of-service (POS) terminals, when the ID is not unique to a specific terminal, Card Acceptor Identification Code can be used along with this field. This field must contain alphanumeric values.

card_a.name: Merchant Category Code
card_a.description: A code designating the principal trade, profession, or line of business in which a merchant is engaged. This field must contain a valid Merchant Category Code (MCC). Please see Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules for valid codes.

card_b.name: Merchant Category Code
card_b.description: A code designating the principal trade, profession, or line of business in which a merchant is engaged. This field must contain a valid Merchant Category Code (MCC). Please see Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules for valid codes.

card_a.name: Persistent FX Eligible Indicator
card_a.description: This field contains a code that identifies if the transaction is eligible for the Persistent FX service. Valid values are: Y (Transaction eligible) l N (Transaction not eligible) l

card_b.name: Persistent FX Eligible Indicator
card_b.description: This field contains a code that identifies if the transaction is eligible for the Persistent FX service. Valid values are: Y (Transaction eligible) l N (Transaction not eligible) l

card_a.name: Rate Table ID

card_b.name: Rate Table ID
card_b.description: This field will contain the rate table ID of the foreign exchange rate table used for currency conversion. The rate table ID contains alpha and numeric values for a total of five characters.

card_b.name: Transaction Code

card_a.description: The field contains the Transaction Code qualifier of the item being returned. This field will contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Transaction Code Qualifier
card_b.description: The field contains the Transaction Code qualifier of the item being returned. This field will contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_a.description: This field contains the Transaction Component Sequence Number of the item being returned. This field will contain a 1.

card_b.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_b.description: This field contains the Transaction Component Sequence Number of the item being returned. This field will contain a 1.

card_a.name: CVV2 Authorization Request Data
card_a.description: Contains CVV2 data for the card-not-present CVV2 service. The Card Verification Value 2 (CVV2) Service is a card verification tool designed to reduce fraud losses on card-not-present and card-present transactions including manual key-entered transactions. Issuers must imprint a 3-digit security number (the CVV2) on the back of all new or reissued Visa cards. Clients can use the CVV2 number to verify that a genuine Visa card is present during a transaction. The field will contain 48.

card_b.name: CVV2 Authorization Request Data
card_b.description: Contains CVV2 data for the card-not-present CVV2 service. The Card Verification Value 2 (CVV2) Service is a card verification tool designed to reduce fraud losses on card-not-present and card-present transactions including manual key-entered transactions. Issuers must imprint a 3-digit security number (the CVV2) on the back of all new or reissued Visa cards. Clients can use the CVV2 number to verify that a genuine Visa card is present during a transaction. The field will contain 48.

card_a.name: CVV2 Result Code
card_a.description: Contains a Card Verification Value 2 (CVV2) verification result for card-not-present transactions and also for card-present CVV2 verifi­ cation-only requests.
card_a.values: M = CVV2 match N = CVV2 does not match P = Not processed S = CVV2 should be on the card, but the merchant has indicated CVV2 is not present U = Issuer not participating (not certified) The ISO field is 44.10.

card_b.name: CVV2 Result Code
card_b.description: Contains a Card Verification Value 2 (CVV2) verification result for card-not-present transactions and also for card-present CVV2 verifi­ cation-only requests.
card_b.values: M = CVV2 match N = CVV2 does not match P = Not processed S = CVV2 should be on the card, but the merchant has indicated CVV2 is not present U = Issuer not participating (not certified) The ISO field is 44.10.

card_a.name: Network Identification Code
card_a.description: This field will include the network identification code. Valid values are 0000-9999. For transactions that do not contain network identification code, this field should contain all zeros.

card_b.name: Network Identification Code

card_b.name: Original Message Type

card_a.name: Persistent FX Eligible Indicator
card_a.description: This field contains a code that identifies if the transaction is eligible for the Persistent FX service. Valid values are: Y (Transaction eligible) l N (Transaction not eligible) l

card_a.name: Rate Table ID

card_b.description: This field will contain the rate table ID of the foreign exchange rate table used for currency conversion. The rate table ID contains alpha and numeric values for a total of five characters.

card_a.name: Trace Audit Number
card_a.description: A number assigned by the message initiator that uniquely identifies a cardholder transaction and all the message types (also known as system transactions) that it comprises, according to individual program rules. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages throughout the life of the transaction. For example, the same trace number is used in an authori­ zation request and response, and in a subsequent reversal request and response, and in any advices of authorization or reversal. The trace number can be used to match a response to its request or to match a message to a given cardholder transaction set. The ISO field is 11.

card_b.name: Trace Audit Number
card_b.description: A number assigned by the message initiator that uniquely identifies a cardholder transaction and all the message types (also known as system transactions) that it comprises, according to individual program rules. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages throughout the life of the transaction. For example, the same trace number is used in an authori­ zation request and response, and in a subsequent reversal request and response, and in any advices of authorization or reversal. The trace number can be used to match a response to its request or to match a message to a given cardholder transaction set. The ISO field is 11.

card_a.name: Card Acceptor Name/Location

card_a.name: Forwarding Institution ID

card_a.name: PACM Diversion Level
card_a.description: Indicates the applicable diversion level when Positive Authori­ zation Capacity Management (PACM) processing is used to route 0100 POS authorization requests or 0400 requests. PACM determines which transactions are processed in STIP and which are forwarded to available issuers. There are 21 PACM diversion levels, and each one indicates a specific dollar amount below which transactions are processed by STIP.
card_a.values: 0 = No Diversion 1 through 20 = Specific Diversion Level in effect Other transactions apply only when the card range is set up for PACM. PACM does not apply to cash disbursements, balance inquiries, status checks, and MOTO or e-commerce transactions. PACM also supports Mastercard transactions.

A leading zero is required to pad the first unused half-byte of this field. The zero is filler and is not a part of the code. This field maps to ISO Field 55, Tag 5F2A-Transaction Currency Code. The ISO field is 148.

card_a.name: Cryptogram Cashback Amount
card_a.description: This field is carried in VSDC transaction and contains the cashback amount that the chip uses when calculating the cryptogram. If the transaction does not include cashback, this field can either not be sent or be sent zero filled. This field maps to ISO Field 55, Tag 9F03-Amount, Other. The ISO field is 149.

card_a.name: Transaction Type
card_a.description: This field is carried in VSDC transactions and indicates the type of financial transaction provided by the terminal. It usually corresponds to the first two digits of the Processing Code and is carried in the message to ensure that the issuer and the card are using the same value to compute the cryptogram. The ISO field is 144.

card_a.name: Card Sequence Number
card_a.description: Contains a number assigned to a specific card when two or more individual cards are associated with the same primary account number, thus enabling issuers to distinguish among different cards linked to the same account. The sequence number can also act as a tracking tool when reissuing cards. For example, the initial card is issued with sequence number one, and when it expires, the card can be reissued with sequence number two, and so on. Although not part of the cryptogram, the sequence number is used by the issuer or Visa to derive the Unique Derivation Key (UDK) from the Master Derivation Key (MDK) when performing Online Card Authentication. This field applies to VSDC full data transactions and Contactless Magnetic Stripe transactions. If the sequence number is present on the chip card, acquirers must include it without modification in requests to avoid a failed Online Card Authentication. If the card sequence number is not present on the chip card, the acquirer may either exclude the field entirely from the request message, or include it with all zeros. The ISO field is 23.

card_a.name: Application Transaction Counter
card_a.description: Contains a count of the transactions performed within the card application. The count increments by one each time a transaction is initiated. Multiple authorization requests for the same transaction will have the same ATC; for example, when online PIN fails and the next authorization represents a different PIN try for the same transaction, the ATC will be the same. For reversals and advices, the ATC is the value from the original message. The ISO field is 137.
